column3: The compaction threshold sets background compaction to start at percent of the window (backgroundTokens = window - reserve - compactAt), keeps a reply room reserve of min(maxTokens, 16k) + 4k with compactAt clamped below it, and keeps a tail of min(20k, compactAt/4); the override table rebuilds on any catalog identity change; with no setting compactAt reports pi's background start
column4: XIN-23 on #54 at 60d5838: reserve alone left pi's 32k background margin, so compaction fired about 32k early and at 50% the 20k kept tail plus a turn re-crossed it every turn; a 32k model at 95% had 1.6k left for output
column5: models.test.ts: 128k at 50% and 80% compacts once after crossing the threshold and not on the next turn; 32k at 90% and 95% compacts at 32768 - 12288; all four fail with pi's default backgroundTokens
